basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old from Manila, Philippines, currently working as a graphic designer. I love exploring new things online and have recently joined Reddit to learn more about various topics and connect with people. In my free time, I enjoy watching Marvel movies and tinkering with my Audi S4. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work. I'm still getting the hang of the platform and often find myself lurking more than posting.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked in the industry for the past few years. Beyond formal education, most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching via online tutorials and forums. I'm passionate about cars, especially Audi models, and enjoy staying updated with Marvel-related media.
